description: Defines the CodecBase class and related buffer management classes for media codec operations in Android's stagefright framework, including callback interfaces, buffer handling, and external dependencies.

classes.name: CodecCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks from CodecBase to MediaCodec, including events like EOS, start/stop, errors, component configuration, surface creation, frame rendering, buffer changes, and tunnel frame readiness.

classes.name: BufferCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks from BufferChannelBase to MediaCodec, including buffer availability and rendering notifications.

classes.name: CodecBase
classes.description: Abstract class representing a media codec, with methods for configuration, control, and callback management.

classes.name: BufferChannelBase
classes.description: Manages buffer passing between MediaCodec and CodecBase, including buffer queuing, attachment, rendering, and conversion utilities.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for CodecBase or BufferChannelBase.

methods.name: getBufferChannel
methods.description: Returns the buffer channel associated with the codec.

methods.name: initiateShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the codec, optionally keeping the component allocated.

methods.name: describeParameter
methods.description: Provides description of a specific parameter.
